statement: A list of $n$ positive integers $a_1 < a_2 < \cdots < a_n$ is \textit{good} if $a_1 + \frac{a_2}{2^2} + \frac{a_3}{3^3} + \cdots + \frac{a_n}{n^n} \leq 2023$. For each $n \geq 1$, determine how many good lists exist.

An infinite grid of lamps, all off. Permitted: select a $3\times3$, $4\times4$, or $5\times5$ square and toggle all lamps in it. (a) Prove any finite set of lamps can be turned on. (b) Prove that using only two of the three square sizes, a $2\times2$ set of lamps cannot be the only ones on.

In a half-plane bounded by line $r$, equilateral triangles $S_1, \ldots, S_n$ are placed with one side parallel to $r$ and the opposite vertex farthest from $r$. Let $T_i$ be the medial triangle of $S_i$; $S$ = region covered by all $S_i$; $T$ = region covered by all $T_i$. Prove $\text{area}(S) \leq 4\cdot\text{area}(T)$.
A sequence satisfies $a_1=1$, $a_2=2$, and $a_{n+1}$ is the largest prime divisor of $a_1 + a_2 + \cdots + a_n$. Find $a_{100}$.

In acute $\triangle ABC$ with $D, E, F$ midpoints of $BC, CA, AB$, the circle with diameter $AD$ meets $AB$ at $P$ and $AC$ at $Q$. Lines through $P$ and $Q$ parallel to $BC$ meet $DE$ at $R$ and $DF$ at $S$. The circumcircles of $\triangle DPR$ and $\triangle DQS$ meet again at $Z$ (and also meet $AB$ at $X$ and $AC$ at $Y$). Prove $Z$ is the midpoint of $XY$.

Let $x_1, \ldots, x_n > 0$ and $S_k = x_1^k + \cdots + x_n^k$. (a) If $S_1 < S_2$, show $S_1, S_2, S_3, \ldots$ is strictly increasing. (b) Prove there exist $n$ and $x_1, \ldots, x_n$ with $S_1 > S_2$ but $S_1, S_2, S_3, \ldots$ not strictly decreasing.
